name: Chess training
title: Chess training | Daily puzzles, tactics and game analysis
description: Improve your chess with daily puzzles, tactics quizzes and calculation practice. Study real games, analyze positions and build a weekly training habit.

/.title: Chess training | Daily puzzles, tactics and game analysis
/.description: Improve your chess with daily puzzles, tactics quizzes and calculation practice. Study real games, analyze positions and build a weekly training habit.

/practice.title: Chess practice
/practice.description: Pick a chess training mode: the daily puzzle, good moves, mate in 1, mate in 3, tactics or calculation practice. Every puzzle comes from a real game.

/practice/daily.title: Daily chess puzzle
/practice/daily.description: Solve a new daily chess puzzle from a real game. Find the best move, explore candidate moves and practice the winning line to sharpen your tactics.

/practice/good-moves.title: Good moves: chess candidate move puzzles
/practice/good-moves.description: Practice chess positions with several good moves and find them all. Puzzles from real games train candidate move thinking.

/practice/mate-in-one.title: Mate in 1 chess puzzles
/practice/mate-in-one.description: Find the mating move in positions from real games. One try per puzzle, with a rating that follows your results.

/practice/mate-in-three.title: Mate in 3 chess puzzles
/practice/mate-in-three.description: Play the mating line move by move in positions from real games. One try per puzzle, with a rating that follows your results.

/practice/tactics.title: Chess tactics quiz
/practice/tactics.description: Test your tactics with a chess puzzle quiz from real games. Solve each position in one try and track how your quiz rating changes as you practice.

/practice/look-ahead.title: Look ahead: chess calculation practice
/practice/look-ahead.description: Practice calculating three moves ahead. Find good lines in real chess positions and consider your opponent's best replies before making your move.

/theory.title: Chess theory
/theory.description: Learn how strong players think, one training method at a time, and practise each one on real positions.

/theory/kotov.title: Candidate moves and the tree of analysis
/theory/kotov.description: Alexander Kotov’s method: list your candidate moves, calculate each one once, then compare and choose. With exercises to practise every step.

/library.title: Chess library
/library.description: Replay real chess games, analyze positions with Stockfish and keep your saved games in one place.

/library/board.title: Chess analysis board
/library/board.description: Analyze chess positions and games with Stockfish. Set up a board, compare candidate moves with engine analysis and save games for further study.

/library/games.title: Chess games to study and solve
/library/games.description: Browse real chess games by theme, level, opening and training focus. Replay each game, study its ideas and solve the key positions along the way.

/library/games/:id.title: Chess game replay and training
/library/games/:id.description: Replay a real chess game move by move. Explore its critical positions, compare candidate moves and practice finding the best continuation.

/library/saved.title: My saved chess games
/library/saved.description: Return to your saved chess games and positions. Review your analysis and continue studying in your personal Chess training library.

/privacy.title: Privacy policy
/privacy.description: What Chess training stores, why, and how to delete your account and data.

/licenses.title: Licenses and credits
/licenses.description: Chess training is free software under the GPL-3.0. Its source code and the projects it builds on, such as Stockfish and Chessground.

/sign-in.title: Sign in
/sign-in.description: Sign in to Chess training with your Google account to save games and keep track of your chess practice.

/profile.title: Your chess training profile
/profile.description: View your Chess training profile, review your practice progress and manage your account preferences.
